fusions.name: Coiled Downstroke
fusions.desc: Uncoils into a chop that deals 30 damage, ignores resistances and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 4 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fang Flick
fusions.desc: A darting chop at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lie Coiled
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 10% while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Venom-Grooved Edge
fusions.desc: Conjures a venom-grooved blade. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
